description: This file contains function prototypes and macro guards related to MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) operations for the Ralink RT2880 Ethernet driver, defining interfaces for link adjustment, read/write operations, and port initialization.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the MDIO link parameters for the specified port.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads a register from the MDIO bus for a given PHY address and register.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register on the MDIO bus for a specified PHY address and register.

methods.name: rt2880_port_init
methods.description: Initializes the port based on device tree node information.
